outputs.explanation: Panel A is a representative spatial-transcriptomics cluster image from a single lung section with no quantification, error bars, or statistical test; no replicate reporting is required.
Panel B shows a representative H&E image with manual region annotation (single section); no quantification or statistics are presented, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
Panel C shows representative H&E and spatial mRNA expression maps from a single annotated section without quantification or statistical comparison; no replicate reporting needed.

replicate_statements: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) from T11b-high versus low squamous tumors (S1&S2 versus S3) with normalized enrichment scores (NES), false discovery rate (FDR) and P values for the indicated gene signatures.
The nominal P and FDR values were obtained from the "GSEA Preranked" tool (from Broad Institute) using a weighted scoring scheme.
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations
outputs.explanation: Panel D reports NES, FDR and P values from a GSEA comparison, which requires replicate information, but the legend only describes the permutation parameter of the statistical test (1000 permutations) without stating how many biological/technical replicates (e.g., sections, animals, or spots per group) underlie the T11b-high vs -low comparison, nor their type.

replicate_statements: Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat's FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat's FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: Panel E presents a bar graph with P values from a statistical comparison (Wilcoxon rank-sum test) of Tmprss11b-high vs -low LUSC spots, but the legend does not state the number of replicates (e.g., spots, sections, or animals) compared in each group, nor explicitly names their type.
